summary_1line: Arjuna drives back Karna and pursues Ashwatthaman while Satyaki battles Alamvusha and slays him, carving through Kaurava forces toward Arjuna.

image_candidates.scene_text: Arjuna releases a blazing arrow from Gandiva that streaks through the sky like Garuda hunting a serpent toward Karna’s chariot.
Satyaki severs Alamvusha’s head with a broad-headed arrow as the watching armies pause around their duel.
Satyaki’s silver-white horses charge through ranks of warriors as he showers arrows, scattering the Kaurava host like clouds in a storm.
